data.name: Clouded Vision
data.description: At 3rd level, the eyebiter can use this ocular occlusion to cause the target to become dazzled for 1 minute and suffer a 20%% miss chance on all attacks the target makes against opponents within 60 feet. Opponents more than 60 feet away have total concealment from the target.
